verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a documented 'Code references' feature, and a community user independently confirms it answers 'Where is this used in code?' for a flag. That covers the code-reference half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows how stale or temporary flags are found or tracked to removal. Missing for 10: stale/unused flag detection, flag lifecycle or temporary-flag status, cleanup/archival workflow guidance, in-depth docs on Code References setup and coverage.
